title: Split-on-Share Mirror code allocation

random_selection.live_conflict_check: git fetch origin --prune; no MA-299 branch found; MA-274 branch exists and remains in the random pool

selection_history.result: competing completed FAIL selectively adopted; fresh sealed by its gate

hypothesis: In a sequential task stream, trialing one scalar Mirror coordinate before allocating a unique full matrix delays private-weight growth for aligned tasks; unrelated tasks trigger a private split. The Mirror policy must improve the byte/quality/compute frontier over native split-on-share, two-coefficient shared-basis, and low-rank-residual controls.
physical_object: A frozen shared 16x16 linear map learned from task zero
mirror_coordinate: One float32 Givens angle per accepted task; fixed pairwise generator G is identified by charged architecture metadata and deterministically reconstructed
logical_multiplicity: Six sequential task maps, with private matrices allocated only when a share candidate fails validation
related_evidence: MA-297 tested Mirror views within a discovered sparse basis and failed its strict quality/compute gate; this candidate isolates the allocation decision before a full private matrix is created.
controls: native no-view split-on-share: private full matrix on validation failure

task.metric: per-task normalized held-out MSE, total/incremental actual serialized inference bytes, private split count, and coordinate-path throughput
task.stream: task 0 defines the shared map; tasks 1-3 are G(m) aligned; task 4 is unrelated; task 5 is a small-residual near-aligned case
task.generator: Y=XW; aligned W_t=W_0 R(m_t), with R(m)=cos(m)I+sin(m)G and G a fixed block-diagonal 2x2 quarter-turn generator; unrelated W is independent; near-aligned W= W_0 R(m)+small independent residual

development.selection_metric: Choose the smallest validation acceptance threshold whose maximum seen-task validation normalized MSE is <=0.01 and whose total payload is minimal; ties choose the smaller threshold. No test values enter the allocation decision.
development.mirror_angle_fit: fixed 4097-point grid on [-pi,pi], training examples only
development.other_fit: least squares for coefficient/private matrices; truncated SVD for rank-1 residual; training examples only

selection_result.rule: 0.01 has minimum payload among thresholds satisfying validation MSE <=0.01; 0.03 ties on bytes, smaller-threshold tie-break selects 0.01

storage.authority: actual deterministic serialized inference payload bytes
storage.codec: typed binary tensor records charge magic/version, field names, dtype, shape, record count, task-kind markers, coordinates, shared weights, private weights, residual factors and method metadata

compute.workspace: Report one prepared 16x16 float32 view matrix (1,024 B) for coordinate methods; count preparation in measured method-path latency.
compute.fit_proxy_definition: Count all five post-root task candidate fits; each Mirror task includes two dense projections plus the 4097-angle scalar objective, plus private fit when rejected. Exact formula is in source/run_screen.py.

success_gate: On every fresh world, Mirror split accepts all three aligned tasks with normalized held-out MSE <=0.01, privately splits the unrelated task when validation requires it, keeps max seen-task normalized MSE <=0.02, and total payload <=0.75x independent-full. A Mirror-specific PROMISING result additionally requires >=10% lower total bytes than the strongest coefficient/residual split control at comparable quality and no >2x inference latency.
failure_gate: The Mirror split fails a fresh quality/split requirement, or a simple native split control matches the useful allocation/quality frontier without a >=10% Mirror byte advantage.
boundaries: Frozen shared map and zero optimizer updates; allocation mechanism, not continual learning
Task IDs are given; no task-agnostic routing

amendments.reason: Post-fresh compute audit found the Mirror angle-fit MAC-equivalent proxy counted only one arriving task instead of all five post-root tasks.
amendments.change: Correct the method-specific fit compute proxy and rerun fresh seeds 29921–29923. Earlier seeds remain valid for their MSE/bytes results but their fit-compute values are invalidated. No model, fit rule, threshold, quality metric, or acceptance gate changes.
